test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the given sentence. 

If you keep dodging your manager's call, you will be __on thin ice. __

options.text: Change plans in the middle of a process

solution:
"The correct answer is option 1: **In a risky situation**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "Thin ice" is a metaphor for a dangerous or risky situation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The phrase "on thin ice" comes from the idea of walking on ice that is so thin it could break and cause someone to fall into freezing water.
 
• In this context, the speaker is warning the listener that if they continue to avoid their manager's calls, they could be in trouble or at risk of losing their job."
